stem:
Bilal notes the Moon's place in the sky from his terrace at 9:00 p.m. on Wednesday. He checks again at 9:00 p.m. on Thursday.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The Moon may appear in a different place in the sky at the same clock time on Thursday.
The Moon does not always rise exactly when the Sun sets.
The Moon returns to exactly the same sky position at the same clock time every night.
Moonrise time never shifts from one day to the next.

teacher.key_rationale: Because the Moon moves ahead in its orbit, its sky place and rise time shift from day to day; it does not always rise at sunset.
